channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: 10-year Treasury note yield hits highest level since 2002 as traders brace for key bond sale
item.description: U.S. Treasury yields climbed Wednesday after retreating in the previous session, as oil prices moved higher.

item.title: ICE came to town and left behind weakened economies
item.description: Research links ICE enforcement surges to lasting declines in local spending, foot traffic and jobs. In Minneapolis, businesses are still recovering.

item.title: Trading platform Webull's China ties create national security risk, congressional panel finds; stock drops 18%
item.description: A congressional committee says trading platform Webull is not the ordinary U.S. company it claims, but exposes customer data to Chinese surveillance risk.

item.title: Used car prices fall in Q3, while demand for fuel-efficient vehicles grows
item.description: Used vehicle prices are forecast to fall more than previously expected this year, according to Cox Automotive.

item.title: Oil edges higher as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery
item.description: Iran's move to step up attacks on tankers which are transiting through the Strait of Hormuz has also led to renewed worries over oil supplies among traders.

item.title: One of the worst parts of the stock market this year is looking like a bargain, says Wolfe Research
item.description: Utilities have gotten the wind knocked out of them in 2026 after back-to-back annual gains.

item.title: Stocks made a record high. Two big bearish trades point to skepticism
item.description: In the State Street SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), about an hour after the opening bell on Tuesday, someone traded a 100,000-lot put spread.

item.title: Rubio says Tehran missed 'multiple' chances for nuclear deal amid Iran stalemate
item.description: Iran has failed to take advantage of "multiple opportunities" to reach a deal on its nuclear program, Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Wednesday.

item.title: France is caught between angry students and unforgiving bond markets
item.description: France's student protests took a breather on Wednesday after weeks of unrest, but market pressure on the French government intensified ahead of budget talks.

item.title: Google ordered to halt work on two data centers in ‘Texas of Europe’
item.description: Finland has emerged as a key location for data centers amid the AI boom.

item.title: The SALT deduction limit is $40,400 for 2026. Here's how to maximize it
item.description: The SALT deduction limit is $40,400 for 2026. Experts cover how to maximize the tax break before year-end.

item.title: Jaguar unveils $130,000 electric vehicle two years after controversial rebrand
item.description: The launch comes as luxury rivals Ferrari and Bentley also push into EVs, seeking to test wealthy buyer's appetite for going electric.

item.title: Porsche braces for lower sales era, seeks lifeline from luxury
item.description: Porsche is bracing for sharply lower sales as it tries to turn its fortunes around with restructuring and a focus on higher-end cars, parent Volkswagen says.

item.title: Meta's Muse assistant tops app charts. Now it needs to become a habit
item.description: Meta’s Muse is free for now as the company searches for a business surrounding its personal AI agent.

item.title: This wearable AI stock is set to rally thanks to a broader business focus, Jefferies says
item.description: A maker of energy efficient computer chips is likely to soar as smart-device hardware and AI compute businesses continue to gain traction, one analyst says.

item.title: Tropical Storm Isaias forms, forecast to become a hurricane and hit the U.S. Gulf Coast this week
item.description: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis declared a state of emergency for 25 counties in the Panhandle and Big Bend regions.

item.title: Home heating oil prices are soaring — and users' winter bills could rise 21%, federal outlook shows
item.description: A tight global diesel market is driving up heating oil prices, with households in the Northeast facing the biggest impact.

item.title: Refinance demand is now half what it was a year ago, as mortgage rates rise again
item.description: Mortgage rates rose to the highest level in nearly three years, causing demand for both refinancing and homebuying to decline even further.

item.title: 'Get your house in order': IMF chief's stark warning for France over surging bond yields
item.description: France is facing a fresh political crisis, as its debt levels and borrowing costs continue to rise.

item.title: Chevron CEO warns against 'unwise' diesel export ban, saying it could make things worse
item.description: His comments come as rising Middle East crude exports and an emergency G7 stockpile release appear to have helped to ease supply fears.

item.title: Trump set to talk to Russia's Putin 'very soon' about plague-related death in Siberia
item.description: Trump says he will speak with Putin “very soon” over a plague incident in Russia as CDC monitor the situation.

item.title: Shopping for a car on Amazon? Compare these auto lenders before financing
item.description: Amazon Autos offers financing through participating lenders, but shoppers should still compare auto loans to find the best rates and terms.

item.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
item.description: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.

item.title: Trump hedges on paying back government for ads that already aired
item.description: The New York Times reported "Trump personally instructed his budget director to use taxpayer money for TV ads praising him and his presidency."

item.title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now
item.description: Unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade poses the biggest risk to markets, according to Singapore state-owned investment giant Temasek.

item.title: Luxury developers flocked to the 'Hamptons of Hungary' — but some projects are stalling
item.description: Lake Balaton in south-west Hungary has been a popular vacation destination for decades, but average transaction prices are falling.

item.title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
item.description: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

item.title: Why AI is both the hope and the hazard for world leaders, according to IMF chief Georgieva
item.description: Kristalina Georgieva warns that the technology lifting growth hopes is also pushing up inflation and yields, just as public debt levels rose.

item.title: DeepSeek considers doubling latest funding round to up to $15 billion, sources say
item.description: China's DeepSeek weighs upsizing funding round to up to $14.9 billion, sources tell CNBC, and the final amount could still change in final talks.

item.title: Anthropic expands Claude Startups program in bid to snag founders and fast-growing companies
item.description: The expansion marks the AI company's latest push to deepen its ties to founders and fast-growing companies.
